The fix clips Xyw with np.maximum(0, Xyw) when positive is True.

category_specific_evidence: Issue #32767 reproducer: ElasticNet(alpha=alpha_min, positive=True, fit_intercept=False) on X=[[1,1],[1,-1]], y=X@[1,-1e3] gives all-zero coef_, but the expected property is that alpha_min (smallest alpha in the ElasticNetCV grid) yields a nonzero positive coefficient (coef_.max() > 0), while alpha_max must give coef_.max() == 0.
Assertion failure message: alpha_min=np.float64(2.0) still gives all zero coef, so alpha_max/alpha_min search range is wrong for positive=True.
Fix in PR #32768: alpha_max and alpha search range made correct for ElasticNetCV(positive=True) and LassoCV(positive=True); enet_path now passes positive=positive to the path computation.

Test test_enet_alpha_max parametrized over positive in [False, True]; X changed to [[3,-1],[2,-5],[5,-3],[1,-4]] with beta=[1,-2] and sample_weight [1,10,1,10] or None, asserting alpha_max makes coefs zero.
Captured stdout from failing test shows X.T @ wy=[733., -476.] before fix versus [733., 476.] after fix, indicating the sign handling of the positive-constrained gradient at alpha_max was wrong.
Failing assertion in test reports ElasticNetCV(alphas=1, cv=2, eps=1, fit_intercept=False, positive=True).alpha_ equal to 66.63636363636364 where zero coefficients were expected.
reproduction_risks: The issue reproducer depends on ElasticNetCV alphas_ grid, so alpha values are data-dependent and not fixed constants.
The reproducer uses a deliberately ill-conditioned target (-1e3 coefficient); results may depend on eps and solver convergence which are not specified in the passages.
The sign-flip in X.T @ wy (-476 vs 476) is the only quantitative evidence of the violated formula; the exact alpha_max formula is not stated in the passages.
Precision and tolerance are not stated in the passages; the test uses assert_allclose at an unspecified tolerance.
